## Parsing notes

- The live spawn file is the one named in the map header: config `server/config.example.lua` has `mapName = "map"`, and the OTBM header of `server/data/world/map.otbm` (OTBM_ATTR_EXT_SPAWN_FILE, read by `server/src/iomap.cpp:188-197`) names `map-spawn.xml` (house file `map-house.xml`). Other `*spawn.xml` files in `server/data/world/` are **not loaded**.
- Spawn positions are `centerx/centery + x/y` and the absolute `z` of each `<npc>` (`server/src/spawn.cpp:182-200`).
- `dynamic` = the name appears in a `doCreateNpc("…")` call (or the NPC list of `globalevents/scripts/start.lua`) in the active Lua tree.
- **Role** is derived from the script file name (and shop parameters for the generic `default.lua`); it is a heuristic label, not game data.
- `tmpCitizen_*.xml` files are regenerated at every start by `systems/027-citizens.lua` and are not listed.
